set.body: Pilot-scoped harness slice (owner D1 approved 2026-10-01, pilot-only scope). Per protocol v3.1 (1dd49723) §4 and §8 v0. Build: (1) an independent Python truth generator for the pilot cells (families TG/TL/TS/TX, amplitudes in data units, TR 1 s, sub-TR onsets, AR noise, SNR per voxel) sharing no normalization, drive builder or basis compiler with PHRF; (2) the TX (Lindquist-Wager IL) distance gate: 1024 unscrambled Sobol points, amplitude-free relative L2 on a 0.1 s grid over [0,48] s, fitted over the Gaussian C0 and Cascade34 PHRF-04 charts (41-point grid, then Nelder-Mead from the best 5), pass when the median >=0.05 to both, with the 10th percentile also reported. No pilot/confirmatory seeds are used; tests use harness seeds only.
set.title: PHRF-CMP v0a: independent truth generator + TX distance gate
